pages.text: $(l)Rotation$()$(br)Create machines run on rotation: make it, carry it on shafts and cogs, spend it. $(item)Engineer's Goggles$() show stress. Power climbs: hand crank, water wheels, windmills, steam engines.
A steam engine on a fluid tank makes a boiler. Crafting it needs your $(item)Steam Core$(). Heat it with a $(item)Blaze Burner$().
Copper and zinc in a heated mixer. Making $(item)brass$() unlocks $(thing)airships$(): levitite to float, propellers to fly.

$(l)The gate$()$(br)Sixteen $(item)Precision Mechanisms$(), made by sequenced assembly with your steam engine powering the line. Keep one: Age V's first tool needs it.$(br2)$(thing)Vein mining$() works from this age on.
